retained_result: Persisted DONE may be cache/audit evidence but is not sufficient semantic authority; terminal closure must be independently re-derivable/revalidatable from exact canonical execution/GWT-use/outcome/credit/delta-or-no-learning/reentry support.
why_killed: Strong conventional closure-trigger receipt tied CCW on malformed-support correctness.
Atomic REENTERED+DONE transaction removed the naive crash-window advantage.
Local matched N=10k benchmark showed CCW point-read median about 3.99x and p95 about 5.13x slower.
why_not_discarded_entirely: CCW omitted the terminal receipt write/table, using about 89.0% of storage and 71.6% of population time in the matched local discriminator.
Read-only derived terminality cannot be directly minted through normal SQLite writes.
After simulated support invalidation, derived closure disappeared automatically while historical persisted receipt remained present.

real_target_evidence_consumed.finding: V17 causal/execution support binding gap reproduced on accepted self-hosted target VPS

next_falsifier: After the conventional V17 support-binding repair reaches target evidence, add one support-quarantine/invalidation control: a historical DONE receipt must not by itself yield causal closure, while verified provider outcome remains durable and no retry authority is minted.
